notes:
robots.txt (www.example.com/robots.txt): Disallow/Allow paths often point at admin/private areas; Sitemap: lists pages.
Well-known URIs (/.well-known/): security.txt, change-password, openid-configuration, assetlinks.json, mta-sts.txt.
Files of interest: .bak, .old, web.config, settings.php, error_log, access_log; dirs like /files/. Also covered in: OSCP PEN-200 Chapter 8 (Introduction to Web Application Attacks). robots.txt Disallow entries reveal admin paths, backup dirs, staging areas. /.well-known/ URIs expose security policy (security.txt), auth endpoints (openid-configuration), and password-change flows. Always check both during web recon. Also covered in: CPTS Ch05 (Information Gathering – Web Edition).
